#e#bBasic Mission: Shattered Dimensions#k#n

#eMission Period#n
12/04/2019 12:00 AM - 12/17/2019 11:59 PM UTC

#b#eEvent Details#n#k
The merging of Maple World and Grandis has created a number of strange spatial anomalies. In one such instance, #rdimensional rifts#k have appeared that are spitting out specter-ified monsters!!

Hunt #e#rmonsters near your level#n#k with the #rRiftbringer#k in your possession to summon a #rdimensional rift#k, then eliminate all of the #rSpecter Monsters#k that come pouring out!

#bYou cannot participate in this mission if you've already reached the daily Glory limit.
